reasons.withdrawn: Dispatch was withdrawn. Use the native workbench to approve a new stage entry if needed.
recovery.warning.withdraw: Only an unclaimed dispatch can be withdrawn. This does not stop a process, move the card or complete the task.
recovery.warning.stop: Request a stop for this exact attempt. Acknowledgment does not prove the execution or checkout has stopped.
recovery.warning.retry: Retry this verified stopped attempt using the same run. This authorizes another CLI quota charge; native admission and completion gates remain required.
recovery.signIn: Sign in as an operator with authentication enabled to perform recovery.
recovery.stale: Refresh the records before confirming an operation.
recovery.unavailable: Recovery prerequisites could not be verified. This does not mean no execution exists.
recovery.loading: Checking native versions and recovery prerequisites.
recovery.blocked: No recovery action is currently verified. Refresh to check native execution, resource release and permissions.
recovery.status.sending: Submitting the confirmed operation. Do not repeat it.
recovery.status.querying: Querying the original operation receipt without resending.
recovery.status.submitted: The native operation receipt is confirmed. Refreshing the records.
recovery.status.stopSubmitted: Stop request recorded. This does not prove the execution stopped or resources were released. Refresh to verify.
recovery.status.unknown: The result is unknown. Query the same operation first; it will not be resent automatically.
recovery.status.rejected: The operation was rejected. Refresh and check permissions and versions before confirming again.
recovery.status.changed: The confirmation is no longer current. Refresh and confirm again.
recovery.status.unavailable: The browser could not retain the operation token. No new request was sent; keep this page and verify the state.
moreChildren: View other subtasks in the workbench
startupDescription: Open Task Command on startup and Home, without changing the saved board view.
release.title: Dispatch to task pool
release.explanation: Select a pool stage in this workflow. Approval is separate from actual queue, claim and start receipts.
release.quota: This moves the task and permits the configured CLI to consume quota. It does not change the executor or bypass dependency, capacity or acceptance gates.
release.signIn: Enable authentication and sign in as an operator to approve tasks.
release.stale: Refresh the stale record before dispatching.
release.unavailable: The task or stage could not be verified. Dispatch is disabled.
release.noTarget: No eligible pool destination in this workflow. The current stage cannot be approved again. Configure a pool in native workflow settings.
release.blocked: Dependencies, occupancy or versions do not permit this action. Refresh to verify; the server checks again.
release.sending: Submitting approval. Do not repeat the action.
release.submitted: Approval submitted. Verifying actual dispatch receipts.
release.unknown: Submission result unknown. Refresh to verify; no automatic resend. This does not prove that dispatch failed.
release.rejected: Request rejected. Refresh and check permissions, dependencies, capacity and versions before approving again.
release.changed: The task or stage changed. This confirmation expired; refresh and confirm again.
title: Kandev · Task command
noMatches: No matching tasks on this page
selectTask: Select a card to inspect its execution
unavailable: Task records are unavailable. Retry; this does not mean the pool is empty.
stale: Refresh needed. Last confirmed records are retained; they do not prove the agent stopped.
pageScope: Up to 50 cards per page. Categories, counts and filters apply only to this page.
noHistory: No approval or claim records yet
terminalNote: An ended attempt does not complete the task. Native acceptance still applies.
recoveryReadOnly: Verify execution first. Opening this page never stops, withdraws or retries work.
missingSelection: This card is no longer on the current page. Return to the list or open the native task.
lastActivity: Recent task activity (not this attempt's heartbeat)
reasons.approval: CLI quota use has not been confirmed for this attempt.
reasons.capability: The agent or executor is unavailable.
reasons.configuration: The pool stage is unconfigured or its configuration changed.
reasons.admission: Stage admission is pending, possibly waiting for capacity.
reasons.dispatch: Approval is saved, but no queue receipt exists yet.
reasons.occupied: This attempt has not been confirmed ended.
reasons.revalidation: Native admission must be revalidated before proceeding.
reasons.history: Native run history was cleaned. Start or stop times cannot be invented.
reasons.evidence: Evidence is incomplete or changed. Verification is required.
